वैबाध॑—प्रणुत्त (˚ध॑-), mfn. forced asunder by the Aśvattha tree, ib.
mf(ई)n. (fr. वि-बुध) belonging or peculiar to the gods, divine, Śiś.; Kathās.; Alaṃkārat.
